title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Rules on Certified Judicial Scriveners) <Supreme Court Regulation No. 2668, June 27, 2016>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on August 4, 2016.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Rules)
(1) through (6) Omitted.

(7) The Rules on Granting Fixed Dates on Housing Lease Contracts and Provision of Information shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 6 (2) 2, "joint judicial scrivener corporation" shall be replaced with "judicial scrivener corporation, limited liability judicial scrivener corporation."
